feature_queries.name: user_static
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.user_id,
  e.timestamp,
  u.user_type,
  u.beer_rating_count,
  u.avg_beer_rating,
  u.place_rating_count,
  u.favorite_count,
  u.total_activity_count,
  date_diff('day', u.created_at, e.timestamp) AS account_age_days
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = e.user_id

feature_queries.name: beer_activity
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.user_id, e.timestamp,
  date_diff('day', max(br.created_at), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_beer_rating,
  sum(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS beer_ratings_7d,
  sum(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beer_ratings_30d,
  sum(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beer_ratings_90d,
  sum(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beer_ratings_180d,
  sum(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beer_ratings_365d,
  count(br.rating_id) AS beer_ratings_all_time,
  count(DISTINCT br.beer_id) AS distinct_beers_all_time,
  avg(br.total_score) AS avg_total_score_all_time,
  stddev_pop(br.total_score) AS std_total_score_all_time,
  avg(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 day') THEN br.total_score ELSE NULL END) AS avg_total_score_90d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN beer_ratings br
  ON br.user_id = e.user_id
 AND br.created_at < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.user_id, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: beer_log_pace
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.user_id, e.timestamp,
    date_diff('day', u.created_at, e.timestamp) AS account_age_days,
    sum(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beer_ratings_30d,
    sum(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beer_ratings_90d,
    sum(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beer_ratings_365d
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = e.user_id
  LEFT JOIN beer_ratings br
    ON br.user_id = e.user_id
   AND br.created_at < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.user_id, e.timestamp, date_diff('day', u.created_at, e.timestamp)
)
SELECT
  user_id, timestamp,
  ln(1 + beer_ratings_30d) AS ln_beer_ratings_30d,
  ln(1 + beer_ratings_90d) AS ln_beer_ratings_90d,
  ln(1 + beer_ratings_365d) AS ln_beer_ratings_365d,
  (beer_ratings_365d * 1.0) / GREATEST(account_age_days, 1) AS beer_rate_per_day_since_signup
FROM base

feature_queries.name: beer_ratio_features
feature_queries.sql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT
    e.user_id, e.timestamp,
    sum(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c30,
    sum(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c90,
    sum(CASE WHEN br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c365
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN beer_ratings br
    ON br.user_id = e.user_id
   AND br.created_at < e.timestamp
   AND br.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 day')
  GROUP BY e.user_id, e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  user_id, timestamp,
  (c30 * 1.0) / (c365 + 1.0) AS frac_30_over_365,
  (c90 * 1.0) / (c365 + 1.0) AS frac_90_over_365,
  (c30 * 1.0) / (c90 + 1.0) AS frac_30_over_90
FROM w

feature_queries.name: availability_activity
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.user_id, e.timestamp,
  count(a.avail_id) AS availability_all_time,
  sum(CASE WHEN a.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS availability_90d,
  avg(CASE WHEN a.is_on_tap THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS frac_on_tap_all_time,
  avg(CASE WHEN a.is_in_bottle THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS frac_in_bottle_all_time
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN availability a
  ON a.user_id = e.user_id
 AND a.created_at < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.user_id, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: place_activity
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.user_id, e.timestamp,
  date_diff('day', max(pr.created_at), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_place_rating,
  sum(CASE WHEN pr.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS place_ratings_90d,
  sum(CASE WHEN pr.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS place_ratings_365d,
  count(pr.rating_id) AS place_ratings_all_time,
  avg(pr.overall) AS avg_place_overall_all_time
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN place_ratings pr
  ON pr.user_id = e.user_id
 AND pr.created_at < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.user_id, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: favorites_activity
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.user_id, e.timestamp,
  date_diff('day', max(f.created_at), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_favorite,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorites_90d,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.created_at >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 day') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS favorites_365d,
  count(f.favorite_id) AS favorites_all_time
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN favorites f
  ON f.user_id = e.user_id
 AND f.created_at < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.user_id, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: time_calendar
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  user_id, timestamp,
  extract(dow FROM timestamp) AS dow,
  extract(month FROM timestamp) AS month,
  extract(year FROM timestamp) AS year
FROM eval_table
